What is ElevenLabs?

The benchmark text-to-speech and voice cloning platform. Produces the most natural synthetic speech available, with instant and professional voice cloning, dubbing, sound effects, music and a conversational agent framework.

Best for

Any application where synthetic speech has to sound genuinely human.

Main features

  • Instant Voice Cloning (from ~1 minute of audio) and Professional Voice Cloning (from ~30 minutes, higher fidelity)
  • Eleven v3 expressive model with emotional and delivery tags
  • Dubbing Studio translating video while preserving the speaker's voice
  • Studio (long-form audiobook and podcast production)
  • Sound Effects generation
  • Conversational AI agent platform with low-latency streaming
  • Voice Library marketplace with revenue share
  • speech-to-text
  • voice isolator.

Practical use cases

  • Narrating an audiobook in a consistent voice
  • dubbing a video into 30 languages keeping the original voice
  • building a low-latency voice agent for a phone line
  • generating character voices for a game
  • accessibility text-to-speech.

Who is it for?

  • Audiobook and podcast producers, game studios, e-learning teams, accessibility products, developers building voice agents.

Pricing, free access & limits

Freemium credit-based subscription; API billed from the same credit pool

Plans described in the source

Free $0 with roughly 10,000 credits/month, watermarked/attribution-required output. Starter around $5-6/mo (roughly 30,000 credits, instant voice cloning). Creator around $22/mo (roughly 100,000-121,000 credits, about 100 minutes, professional voice cloning, higher audio quality). Pro around $99/mo (roughly 600,000 credits, about 600 minutes, 44.1kHz PCM via API, 192kbps). Scale around $299-330/mo (roughly 1.8-2M credits, 3 workspace seats, 3 professional clones). Business around $990-1,320/mo (roughly 6M credits, 10 seats, 10 professional clones, low-latency TTS around 5 cents/minute). Enterprise custom. Annual billing cuts roughly 17%. Credit allowances vary slightly by source - confirm on the official page.

Free plan

Yes - free tier with roughly 10,000 credits/month, but with attribution requirements and limited commercial rights.

Free trial

No separate time-boxed trial; the free tier is the evaluation route. Some partner programmes offer extended free access.

Usage limits to consider

Credit-metered, roughly 1,000 credits per minute of speech. A real-time conversational voice agent burns credits far faster than plain narration. Professional Voice Cloning requires a Creator tier or above. Free tier requires attribution and restricts commercial use.

Strengths & tradeoffs

These points summarize the supplied research, rather than hands-on test results.

Strengths noted in the source

  • Output quality is the clear category benchmark - the gap to competitors is audible
  • voice cloning from one minute of audio is genuinely remarkable
  • Dubbing Studio preserving the speaker's voice across languages is a standout
  • the conversational agent platform with sub-second latency is production-grade
  • Voice Library gives voice actors a revenue share.

Limitations to consider

  • Credits disappear extremely fast on conversational agents - a busy phone line can exhaust a Pro plan in days
  • voice cloning creates serious consent, impersonation and fraud exposure requiring governance
  • Arabic quality is good but below English
  • pricing tiers and credit allowances have been revised repeatedly and third-party sources disagree
  • no on-premises option.

Platforms, languages & integrations

Platforms

  • Web, iOS, Android, API, Chrome extension
  • Studio web app

Languages

  • 70+ languages including Arabic and French; v3 model handles multilingual within a single generation

API access

Yes - comprehensive REST and WebSocket API for streaming, with official SDKs; the API is the primary route for production use

Integrations and exports

  • Zapier, Make, Twilio, LiveKit, Vapi, Descript, Adobe Premiere (via export), WordPress, Shopify, LangChain

Evaluation notes

Model cost per minute of finished audio, not per credit - and separately for agents, which consume 5-10x narration rates. Establish written consent before cloning any real person's voice; the legal exposure is significant and jurisdiction-dependent.
